title: Bills
description: Stores utility bills with account holder, period, amount, currency, and meter reading data for tracking and reconciliation.

provider.description: Utility provider — PPC, EYDAP, Heron, Cosmote, Vodafone

category.description: Utility category: electricity, water, gas, internet, mobile

tariff_details.description: Tariff name or rate details if known

notes.description: Extra notes — account holder, meter ref

vendor.description: Vendor or utility provider name, e.g. Heron Thermansi

amount.description: Bill amount with currency symbol, e.g. '€58.20'

bill_type.description: Type of utility bill, e.g. gas, electricity, water

meter_reading.description: Actual meter reading value for the billing period; may be null when not yet recorded

account_holder.description: Name of the person responsible for the bill account
